categories.main_business_segments: Phoenix International Travel Service Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the travel agency industry, offering a wide range of travel services including ticket sales for domestic and international air, land, and sea transportation, visa processing, tour arrangement, group travel organization, and travel-related services. The company also engages in cruise travel, incentive travel for corporate clients, and operates subsidiaries in related sectors such as insurance agency, publishing, fitness, and logistics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced travel packaging expertise, including itinerary design, cost estimation, and market analysis, supported by decades of experience and a specialized team. It utilizes computerized reservation systems like Sabre and Travelport for ticketing and booking, and has developed mobile applications (Phoenix Travel Cloud APP) to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency. The company emphasizes quality control through ISO 9001 certification and continuous staff training.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Phoenix serves a broad consumer base including individual travelers, corporate clients for incentive and group travel, and international tourists visiting Taiwan. Key markets include Europe, North America, Australia/New Zealand, Asia (including Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, China), and cruise destinations. The company targets both mass market and high-end luxury travel segments, including specialized tours such as European river cruises and Antarctic expeditions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with branch offices in major cities including Taipei, Taoyuan, Hsinchu, Taichung, Chiayi, Tainan, and Kaohsiung. Its travel products cover global destinations across Europe, the Americas, Oceania, Asia, and cruise routes. It also has overseas investments and partnerships, including subsidiaries and joint ventures in Shanghai and Mongolia, and represents various international airlines.
categories.supply_chain_position: Phoenix functions mainly as a midstream travel service provider, acting as an intermediary between upstream suppliers such as airlines, cruise lines, and local tour operators, and downstream end customers. It also vertically integrates by holding airline agency rights and managing related subsidiaries in insurance, logistics, and hospitality, enhancing control over supply and service quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes sustainable development and ESG compliance, having obtained environmental certifications and actively promoting green travel products. It focuses on continuous product innovation by adding new elements to existing tours and developing niche travel themes like aurora viewing and cultural festivals. Digital transformation is emphasized through mobile apps and e-commerce platforms to improve customer engagement and operational efficiency. Strategic expansion includes acquiring airline agency rights and diversifying into related businesses.
categories.revenue_model: Phoenix generates revenue primarily through sales of packaged tours, ticketing commissions from airlines and cruise lines, and service fees for travel-related arrangements. Additional income streams include insurance agency commissions, publishing, fitness services, and property investments. The company also benefits from corporate incentive travel contracts and chartered flights or cruises.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a mature and highly competitive travel industry with pressures from online travel agencies and low-cost carriers. Phoenix differentiates itself through high-quality service, extensive global product offerings, and strong brand reputation, supported by multiple industry awards. Its vertical integration and diversified subsidiaries provide competitive advantages in supply chain control and service breadth.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Phoenix reported consolidated operating revenue of approximately NT$3.14 billion in 2024, a 42.76% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to owners of NT$301.72 million and earnings per share of NT$3.75. The company has shown strong growth post-pandemic, with increased assets totaling NT$3.46 billion and equity of NT$1.85 billion. It maintains a stable capital structure and continues to invest in property and business diversification.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Phoenix emphasizes professional, high-quality, and innovative travel services with a strong brand trusted by consumers and corporate clients. It offers diverse and customized travel products, including exclusive chartered cruises and luxury tours, supported by experienced staff and comprehensive service. The company’s commitment to sustainability, digital innovation, and integrated supply chain management enhances customer convenience and loyalty, setting it apart in a competitive market.
